notes.title: Respawn bug fix (hopefully)
notes.content: Thanks to Mr Cevri, he has spotted some crucial bugs and i've fixed them immediately.

notes.title: Level7 is rearranged.
notes.content: Previously, There were some patterns to pass the level 7 but these were found confusing by the players so  in this mini patch the patterns are removed and now the Level 7 is easier!

notes.title: Level 4
notes.content: Based on player feedback, the glass and poison gas in Level 4 have been removed. Also a warning panel added for to prevent overriding game saves.

notes.title: The tutorial part is compulsory
notes.content: Because players were allowed to dive right into the game, many players were unable to figure out the mechanics and keybindings in the game.

notes.title: "FLASHING LIGHTS!" Achievement Added!
notes.content: You can unlock the new achievement by turning on your flashlights for the first time! This was actually an easter egg for a friend of mine named Reyhanlioglu!

notes.title: Coward Achievement Bug Fixed.
notes.content: After re-designing the level 3 there was a minor bug which prevents to unlock the "Coward!" achievement. It is fixed properly.

notes.title: Auto Save is Imported and Level 3 is more easy!
notes.content: In this patch, i have imported auto-save and made too easy to play the level 3. You don't have to fight after pulling lever.
